name: labs/masahiro-999__oscilloscope-mcp
title: RIGOL DS1000Z-series oscilloscope (RigolDs1000z)
intro: RIGOL DS1000Z-series oscilloscope (RigolDs1000z), adapted from masahiro-999/oscilloscope-mcp. It reads `identity`, `active_channel_count`, `acquire_memory_depth`, `acquire_sample_rate` and 3 more; sets `channel_1_scale`, `channel_1_offset`, `channel_1_probe`, `channel_1_coupling` and 8 more; runs `measure` and `run_control`. `measure`: read the scope-side automatic measurements for one or more items on a channel. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
